as_told.title: Jake Barber retrieves an egg-shaped craft

plain: A former helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says that he and his team picked up an egg-shaped craft, about 20 feet long, and carried it by helicopter out of the California desert. He tells it at first hand, saying they simply called it "the egg" because that is what it looked like. Jesse Michels repeats the story more than once and calls the egg extraterrestrial, and a congressman named Eric Burlison recalls Barber describing it, which would mean the US secretly recovers craft that are not man-made.
